n5ddf080d5b.headline: The Senate approved the controversial tax moratorium: its main points
n5ddf080d5b.summary: The Argentine Senate passed a tax moratorium criticized for favoring businessmen involved in criminal cases, raising concerns about fiscal policy fairness.
n5ddf080d5b.why: Tax moratoriums affect government revenue and business compliance; controversial measures can impact investor confidence and economic governance.
